title: Rebelle 8 review: This impressive painting software let me turn my MacBook into a full-blown canvas
summary: Escape Motions’ Rebelle 8 attempts to replicate real-world brushes and canvases in a digital environment, and does an excellent job at that - as long as you’ve got a powerful enough computer to run it.
